chunks: The strong one is the one who overcomes himself (nafs).

key_terms.غَلَبَ: overcame, subdued, or gained mastery over
key_terms.نَفْسَهُ: his own self or nafs, meaning the inner self that must be disciplined

ai.seo_question: Who is considered truly strong in the Prophetic tradition?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that true strength is not merely physical power, but mastery over one’s own nafs. It emphasizes inner discipline, self-control, and moral struggle as marks of real strength in the Prophetic tradition.
